plainTranslation: A's structure meets B's depth and power. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility press against your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed.
summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility press against your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
